Card Q&A.a: They trigger simultaneously, so you can choose their activation order.
Card Q&A.q: I activate this card's inherited effect and DNA digivolve using two Digimon then attack with the digivolved Digimon.At this time, in what order can I activate the [When Digivolving] and [When Attacking] effects on that DNA digivolved Digimon?

Inherited Effect: [End of Your Turn] This [VB] trait Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a [VB] trait Digimon card in the hand. Then, that DNA digivolved Digimon may attack.
